title: SaS-Math AI Game Config
description: DRAFT v0.1 — single source of truth for the game math config. Generates TypeScript (frontend), Pydantic (ai-layer), and Rust serde (core-math). See docs/design-decisions.md ADR-004. Money is always in integer smallest-units (ADR-002). This draft covers a 5x3 lines game; finalized and wired to codegen in M1.

schema_version.description: Bump on ANY schema change. Old configs must reproduce identical math forever (ADR-004).

bet_units.description: Total bet for one spin, in integer smallest-units (the RTP denominator).

denomination_scale.description: Smallest-units per credit (e.g. 100 = cents). For rendering only.

substitutes_for.description: For wilds: symbol ids this wild substitutes (scatters usually excluded).

reels.description: Exactly one representation. 'strips' = physical reel strips (preserves adjacency/positional structure). 'weights' = virtual-reel symbol weights per reel (solver-friendly; must be realized to a strip and re-verified, ADR-006).

strips.description: One array of symbol ids per reel.

paytable.description: Per symbol id, the payout (in bet_units multiples * 1, integer smallest-units) for each winning count.

pays.description: Map of match-count -> payout in integer smallest-units. e.g. {"3": 500, "4": 2000, "5": 10000}.

paylines.description: Each payline is a row index (0-based) per reel. Length must equal game.grid.reels.

line_eval.description: Win-evaluation semantics. The #1 place parity tests fail at the 2nd-3rd decimal; the chosen rule is part of the certified math.

max_win.description: Hard cap, modeled INSIDE the math, not as a post-step (ADR-005).

cap_x.description: Max total win as a multiple of total bet (e.g. 5000).

generator.description: Counter-based, namespaced RNG (ADR-003). Only 'chacha' (ChaCha8) is implemented; the engine rejects anything else rather than silently substituting.

features.description: Modular 'Lego-block' mechanics. Empty for the v0.1 base lines game; expanded in M4 (cascades, expanding wilds, multipliers) with declared recursion caps (ADR-011).

targets.description: Optional solver targets (M2). Not part of the math; consumed by the auto-tuner.
